entities.summary: Gabriel Piguet (French pronunciation: [ɡabʁijɛl piɡɛ]; was the Roman Catholic Bishop of Clermont-Ferrand, France. Involved in Catholic resistance to Nazism, he was imprisoned in the Priest Barracks of Dachau concentration camp in 1944.
